newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates jump on borrowing interest.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates jump on borrowing interest.

text.p: Pakistani money rates jumped towards Monday's close as borrowers chased scarce lenders and dealers said rates would remain firm at Tuesday's opening.
"Overnight rates fluctuated at three to 10 percent early in the day. But the complexion changed near the close as overnight calls shot to 13 and then 14.5 percent," a dealer said.
"Borrowers could not cover their positions even at 20 percent and the market seemed to end short," he said.

Dealers said banks had to approach the State (central) Bank of Pakistan for moderate amounts. One-week deals were struck around 11 percent. Two-week borrowers could not cover themselves at around 14 percent, while three-month bids and offers were quoted at 14.75 and 15.60 percent respectively, dealers said.
